why: Item 1 of the must_not list is avoided. Check 3 lists every exported function, names subtract and fails if "any exported function is missing from README.md", so documenting clamp alone fails. Check 2 tests only `instanceof RangeError` and does not require a message. Check 1's exact values follow from the clamp definition. Check 3's PASS condition breaks item 2, though. It requires "its name and signature plus a description of what it does". Expect line 3 only says README.md "documents every function", and nothing in it asks for signatures. A README line such as "`subtract` returns a minus b" documents the function but has no signature, so this check would fail it. That is a requirement about parameters and layout that line 3 does not make. The note "the form and position in the file can be anything" relaxes the layout but keeps the signature requirement.
